final_straight_slope_policy.definition: true when the current JRA flat course has a material uphill section in the home/final straight before the finish; false when the final straight is flat or downhill/no material uphill is documented
final_straight_slope_policy.source_policy: JRA official racecourse/course descriptions and official course-feature pages
final_straight_slope_policy.scope: current JRA flat turf/dirt geometry only

course_size_class_policy.definition: deterministic project-derived class from reference circuit circumference_m; it is not a JRA label and does not encode turn radius
course_size_class_policy.null_policy: non-circuit/combined layouts without a single canonical circumference remain null
